source.test: scanServerDirectory (Bedrock server.properties missing -> raw defaults, not BedrockPropertiesModel)

notes: With no server.properties at all, rawProps is empty and scanServerDirectory falls back to its own inline defaults: port 19132 (line 249) and maxPlayers 20 (line 250) — the same 20 used for Java. This diverges from BedrockPropertiesManager's typed BedrockPropertiesModel.maxPlayers default of 10 (BedrockPropertiesManager.swift:25), which scanServerDirectory never consults — it calls BedrockPropertiesManager.readRawProperties directly, not readModel. Port the 20 default, not 10, for this scan path.
